facts.fact: 几个晚上后，Kyle 端着偷来的 kombucha 对 Bethany 说：“You have to try not to think of them as people.”
facts.anchor: “You have to try not to think of them as people,” Kyle told her a few nights later over stolen kombucha.

facts.fact: Kyle 是 Bethany 到岗时唯一真正友善欢迎她的人；他已在这家公司待了九个月——是其他任何 content moderator 任期长度的两倍（他好炫耀这一点）。
facts.anchor: He’d been at the company for nine months (twice as long as any of the other content moderators, as he was quick to brag).

facts.fact: Bethany 打定主意：一旦摆脱男友 Abel 的掌控，绝不再跟 cis 男约会——因此起初把 Kyle 的多次餐厅邀约当约会婉拒；第一周下班后噩梦开始加速，第二周末尾她终于答应，跟 Kyle 下楼到 retro diner 风格的员工餐厅（每晚 15 分钟休息）。
facts.anchor: So now, near the end of week two, when Kyle asked once again if she wanted to join him on her break, Bethany finally acquiesced and followed him downstairs to the staff cafeteria built to look like a cute retro diner.

facts.fact: Kyle 点破招聘套路：电话里说得 vague and upbeat、专挑走投无路的人，然后 “wham: They hit you with the atrocity exhibition”；他还说自己已见过 dozens 的 content moderators 来来去去。
facts.anchor: “That’s how they get you in the door,” Kyle said. “They keep it vague and upbeat on the phone, attract people who are so desperate for a gig they don’t think to ask questions, and then wham: They hit you with the atrocity exhibition.”

facts.fact: Kyle 说自己想拍真正的电影（不是垃圾 GlobalVill 视频），做这份工作是为攒钱上 film school。
facts.anchor: “I want to make movies,” he said. “Not shitty GlobalVill videos. Real movies. I took this job to save up for film school, thinking it’d be a good way to make some quick cash.

facts.fact: Kyle 讲他的化粪池理论：moderators 是 “Shit-scrubbers”，时薪 “Thirty dollars an hour”，做到做不下去就 quit；Bethany 起身说休息已经过了二十分钟。
facts.anchor: Moderators. Shit-scrubbers. Thirty dollars an hour. We do it as long as we can, and then we quit and try to wash the stink off ourselves, if we even still can anymore.

facts.fact: Kyle 问 Bethany 是不是 transgender，她答 “Yeah. I am.”；Kyle 说 “My sister was trans, too.”（用的是过去时），之后说自己此生再也不会跟父母说话。
facts.anchor:
“I thought so. My sister was trans, too.”


Was. The word hung in the air. Kyle picked up his glass and mug and walked the dishes over to the sink.

facts.fact: 临别时 Kyle 请 Bethany 帮个忙：“Don’t let them grind you into pea dust, yeah? Don’t let them make you disappear.”
facts.anchor: “Hey, let me ask you a favor,” Kyle said. “Don’t let them grind you into pea dust, yeah? Don’t let them make you disappear.”
